# ARCHITECTURE

<!-- Generated by scripts/architecture-map.mjs from plans-schema.js, docs/architecture/registry.json and a scan of server/ and scripts/. Do not edit by hand: edit the registry or the code, then run `npm run map:architecture`. test/architecture-map.test.js fails CI when this page is stale. -->

How a number reaches Nick: the refresh loop runs the producer offline, the producer writes one plans file,
and the server only reads that file. One number has one producer; a screen shows the served value, never a
local recomputation. Routes and tables (what feeds what) are mapped separately in `docs/wiring/WIRING-MAP.md`.

```
refresh loop -> scripts/campaign/produce-plans.mjs -> planner.js (search, confirm dice, Nick's rules)
             -> view.js (typed fields) -> plans.json -> war-room-view.js -> War Room / Today / Coach
```

Every served number is a typed field: `{ status: ok | unknown | failed, value, source, se, ... }`. A missing
number is `unknown` with a reason, never 0. `source` names the producer below.

## Producers (one producer per number)

| producer | owns |
|---|---|
| `scripts/campaign/produce-plans.mjs#buildPlansFile` | plans.json, the War Room file: one entry per league, rewritten by the refresh loop. Nothing on the request path computes a plan. |
| `server/services/campaign/planner.js#planLeague` | one league's plan: candidate paths, the confirmed best move, the deck, risk modes, catch-up, partners. |
| `server/services/season-sim.js#simulateSeason` | title odds and playoff odds (the season Monte Carlo). |
| `server/services/season-sim.js#tradeImpact` | a trade's title-odds change, on paired seeds. |
| `server/services/lineup-week-range.js#lineupWeekRange` | the weekly points range for a lineup (locks and settled points included). |
| `server/services/trade-acceptance.js#acceptanceBand` | the acceptance band a P(yes) is the midpoint of. |
| `server/services/p-yes.js#pYesFor` | the served P(yes) for an offer, whichever model is switched on. |
| `server/services/fc-value.js#fcValues` | market value (FantasyCalc). |
| `server/services/people/player-score.js#scorePlayers` | the 0-100 blue-chip score and its label (Blue chip is 83+). |
| `server/services/campaign/never-give.js#ruleVerdict` | no number: the pass or refuse verdict for Nick's rules on any give/get. Every served trade passes it. |
| `server/services/number-audit.js#runNumberAudit` | the number-health rows (ok / warn / broken per check). |
| `server/services/war-room-view.js#warRoomView` | no number: reads plans.json and serves it to the War Room. A reader, never a second producer. |

## plans.json sections

Every section of a league entry in the War Room file (21), in schema order. "typed numbers" counts the number and probability fields inside it.

| section | optional | typed numbers | computed by | what |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `attention` | no | 0 | `scripts/campaign/produce-plans.mjs#attentionRows` | which league needs Nick first, ranked across leagues. |
| `destination` | no | 3 | `server/services/campaign/planner.js#planLeague` | where the best plan ends: the roster and its title odds. |
| `feasibility` | no | 2 | `server/services/campaign/objectives.js#pointsFeasibility`, `server/services/campaign/objectives.js#targetFeasibility` | can the goal be reached, by when, at what cost. |
| `feasibility_points` | no | 3 | `server/services/campaign/feasibility.js#sidePanelFeasibility` | the points question on a league planned on something else. |
| `finder_best_expected` | no | 1 | `scripts/campaign/league-adapter.mjs#pickFinderBest` | the Trade Lab finder's best single offer, beside the plan's. |
| `next_move` | no | 10 | `server/services/campaign/planner.js#planLeague`, `server/services/campaign/serve-regret.js#holdStepRegret` | the one move to make now, after the confirm dice. |
| `alternatives` | no | 10 | `server/services/campaign/planner.js#deckOf` | the rest of the deck (at most five). |
| `itinerary` | no | 2 | `server/services/campaign/itinerary.js#buildItinerary` | the plan's stops plus Nick's own stops and untouchables. |
| `stop_tradeoffs` | no | 3 | `server/services/campaign/itinerary.js#stopTradeOff` | what adding or removing a stop costs. |
| `flip_map` | no | 7 | `server/services/campaign/search.js#flipMap` | buy-from-one, sell-to-another routes. |
| `targets` | no | 2 | `server/services/campaign/search.js#searchTarget` | players worth going after, with the best path to each. |
| `catch_up` | no | 2 | `server/services/campaign/catchup.js#orderCatchUp` | free, flip, desperate, swing and timing moves, in order. |
| `speed_curve` | no | 5 | `server/services/campaign/speed.js#speedCurve` | cost of arriving by week N. |
| `brain_report` | no | 0 | `server/services/campaign/brain-gate.js#brainReportSection` | the report card (E1-E7 and graders). |
| `number_health` | no | 0 | `server/services/campaign/brain-gate.js#readNumberHealth`, `server/services/number-audit.js#runNumberAudit` | which served numbers are ok, warn or broken. |
| `risk_modes` | no | 5 | `server/services/campaign/modes.js#compareModes` | safe / balanced / all-in best plans on the same dice, beside doing nothing. |
| `partners` | no | 1 | `server/services/campaign/partners.js#rankPartners` | who to deal with: P(responds) and the best edge through that team. |
| `teams` | yes | 0 | `scripts/campaign/league-adapter.mjs#teamNames` | who each roster is, read at run time and never committed. |
| `blue_chips` | yes | 3 | `server/services/people/player-score.js#buildBoard` | the scored player board. |
| `ladders` | yes | 8 | `server/services/campaign/ladder.js#ladderCards` | depth to level-below to blue-chip chains (shadow). |
| `p_yes_basis` | yes | 0 | `server/services/p-yes.js#pYesBasis`, `server/services/p-yes-blend.js#basisSummary` | which P(yes) model the steps serve, with each model's record. |

## Where each served number comes from (source ids)

The `source` on every typed field is one of these 17 ids.

| source | producer | what |
|---|---|---|
| `sim.title` | `server/services/season-sim.js#tradeImpact` | title odds and their change from the season sim. |
| `clone.accept` | `server/services/trade-acceptance.js#acceptanceBand` | P(yes) from the acceptance band (the default with no P(yes) flag on). |
| `clone.price` | `server/services/campaign/playbook.js#priceLadder` | opening offer and walk-away price, on the partner's screen. |
| `market.fc` | `server/services/fc-value.js#fcValues` | market value. |
| `plan.path` | `server/services/campaign/planner.js#planLeague` | anything read off the chosen plan (moves, deck, itinerary). |
| `coach.text` | `server/services/reasoning/plan-reasoning.js#applyReasoning`, `server/services/campaign/messages.js#applyCoachMessages` | model-written text: reasoning panels and offer messages. |
| `eval.check` | `server/services/campaign/brain-gate.js#brainReportSection` | grader results. |
| `audit.numbers` | `server/services/campaign/brain-gate.js#readNumberHealth` | number-audit results. |
| `campaign.plan` | `scripts/campaign/produce-plans.mjs#buildPlansFile` | run-level facts (attention rank, run status). |
| `plan.template` | `server/services/campaign/playbook.js#stepMessage` | text built by a template from engine facts only. |
| `chat.labels` | `scripts/campaign/chat-labels.mjs#chatRowsFor` | chat-DB labels and counts, never chat text. |
| `asset.ros` | `server/services/campaign/catchup.js#freeMoves` | a player's rest-of-season points a game (waiver claims). |
| `people.score` | `server/services/people/player-score.js#scorePlayers` | the blue-chip score. |
| `fp.ros` | `server/services/people/fantasypros-ros.js#rosCollector` | FantasyPros rest-of-season rank. Internal comparison only: never displayed (Nick's rule). |
| `activity.accept` | `server/services/p-yes.js#pYesFor` | P(yes) from the activity baseline (GRIDIRON_PYES_BASELINE). |
| `blend.accept` | `server/services/p-yes-blend.js#blendP` | P(yes) from the graded blend of baseline and clone (GRIDIRON_PYES_BLEND). |
| `usage.xfp` | `server/services/campaign/buy-low.js#scoreBuyLow` | usage up, points down (xFP) for buy-low reads. |

## Flags: switches (109)

A unit switches on only through its own flag, never through `GRIDIRON_PREVIEW_UNCONFIRMED`. An unproven unit stays off or in shadow until its pre-registered bar passes. "preview-aware file" means a file naming the flag also reads preview mode; read that file before assuming preview leaves it off.
